subject: C6g render fixes for c6fc: results
body: (1) indexed_expand rc=-1: the draw is a generic per-RT MRT draw (2 attachments, slot1 mask0) whose fragment can framebuffer-fetch (luma_boost_lph SubpassData idx0; fixed_frag variants with fc_framebuffer_fetch). generic_snapshot then allocated two whole-target snapshot buffers per encoder (1125x2436 BGRA = 11.2 MB each; log shows NORD2 GPU MAP bytes=11239424) and returned a bare -1 when that failed, inside the 256 MiB per-process GPU VA context. Snapshots are only needed when the draw writes >=2 targets AND fetches one of them; now gated on genericRtActive and the SPIR-V InputAttachmentIndex mask; fetch of an unwritten attachment reads its memory directly. Snapshot alloc failure now rc=-16 with trace; every snapshot_rt precondition -1 now names its clause (TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_REFUSED). Not reproduced on host as a failure (host has no VA budget): host proves the c6fc shapes (imported 1125x2436 display target, mask0 RT1, n=6 uint16 indexed, fixed_frag with captured constants, luma_boost) draw with zero copies. (2) f43 = BGR5A1Unorm (arch9 B5G5R5A1, Mesa pan_format.c): n2r RT/clear/blend/tib/legacy-sample support added; passes now admitted. Also fixed MRT tile-buffer sizing to Mesa pan_format_tib_size (R8 is 4 B/px in TIB, was 1). Pipelines/draws still need Rust (Item C posted). (3) sampled-only single-plane IOSurface ('LA08'/'2C08'->RG8, 'L008'->R8, RGBA/BGRA) -> exact owned shadow, refreshed per command buffer, never written back. (4) TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED now names job index/kind/fs/target/copies/bindings (compute_frontend.m 1-line call, helper in render_encoder.inc). Gates: iOS -Werror x3 variants OK; run_host_tests all PASS except NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN probe; integration 1005 checks, only failure = unrevised natural-stride CA oracle (Item B); render harness PASS; ca_backboardd_host_test 31 checks PASS ASan+release, pending=1 (f43 Rust).
